paragraphs: R. Chiyya son of R. Bun, in the name of R. Yosi son of R. Chanina: Demai, chapter 3, halakhah 4. And R. Zeira and Abba bar Tachlifa, in R. Hoshaya's name: Maaser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 7. In R. Shammai's name. There is also R. Avin bar Chiyya.
